Nutrition counseling: Coordinate with patient and wife to ensure appro-
priate foods and beverages are available for consumption. Discuss ex-
pected acute and long-term side effects from surgery. Establish slow, 
steady weight gain and physical activity goals for next 3 months.
Nutrition Monitoring and Evaluation
	1.	Body weight trends
	2.	Hydration status
	3.	Serum pre-albumin levels and creatinine levels (over 3 months)
	4.	Physical activity
	5.	Schedule follow-up session in 2 weeks, with optional phone call 
between visits
